mission.title: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery
mission.foundation: Barrot V3 remains the execution, orchestration, safety and verification foundation.

correction.reason: The previously recorded derived spread does not reproduce from the bid, ask and midpoint preserved in the same observation. This correction supersedes only the derived spread value; the original artifact and all captured quote fields remain unchanged.

source_capture.basis: Arithmetic recomputation from the rendered bid/ask values in the referenced artifact; not a new exchange observation.

scope_limits: Do not rewrite the original snapshot.
Do not alter last trade, bid, ask, sizes, 24-hour statistics, event timestamp or capture timestamp.
Do not interpret the spread correction as a trading signal or market-direction evidence.
Do not promote the rendered observation into the point-in-time feature store.
